transcript: Never forget the time a Youtuber broke into London's National Theatre and spent the night there without anyone catching him. Or rather, he did get caught and he still got away with it. The Youtuber was Ally Law, who did a lot of videos about trespassing and spending the night places he's not supposed to be. And they got into the National Theatre after hours, first by climbing up to one of the upper balcony levels outside, then trying a bunch of random doors on the upper levels until they found one that happened to be unlocked. They put on reflector vests at first in the employee area to seem like they could possibly belong, and very quickly they found themselves in the flyspace for the Olivier Theatre, which is massive. Then they proceeded to free climb at a very dangerous height. At one point, he was climbing and found this dusty ledge and he drew a 🍆 in the dust. But what was funny was that other 🍆s had already been drawn in the dust, meaning that they were drawn by National Theatre employees. And they went down to the stage level of the Olivier. And this was in 2017, I believe the National Theatre was doing Follies and they just played around on the set, which, frankly, is a dream. But while they were on the stage, they were approached by a security guard. Luckily for them, they had both already taken off their reflector vest, so they were able to pretend that they were actors just there for a late night rehearsal. I feel really bad for the security guard who was caught on camera basically buying their lie saying, “alright, have a good night.” So then they went back up to one of the upper levels into like an office area and slept on a curtain. And they left the next morning out through a door on the roof and climbing down the side of one of the staircases because it was blocked off by a gate. Naturally, because all of this was uploaded on YouTube for anyone to see. The National Theater responded. They said, we are shocked and concerned that two intruders recently put themselves at great risk by gaining unauthorized access to a restricted area of the building. We would like to reassure audiences that we have taken immediate action to further strengthen our security.
